name: GlobalSecureAccessInternetProfile
label: Manage the Internet traffic forwarding profile
helpText: Chooses who gets their internet traffic sent through Global Secure Access on devices with the client installed: everyone, nobody, or selected groups for a pilot. Groups assigned by hand are left alone. Requires 'Onboard Global Secure Access' first and an Entra Internet Access license.
executiveText: Controls which staff have internet traffic routed through the company's network security service on managed devices: everyone, nobody, or a pilot group first.
docsDescription: Checks the Internet traffic profile: on or off, its policy links, and who it is assigned to. Sets the profile state, enables any disabled policy links, and assigns all users and devices, nobody, or the selected groups (wildcards allowed). Users, groups and devices assigned by hand are kept.

assignTo.label: Who should this profile be assigned to?

options.label: Assign to all users and devices

customGroup.label: Custom group name (if assigning to a custom group; wildcards allowed)
